responsibility: Defines SPARC inline-assembly register classes and registers, including 32-bit versus 64-bit type support, `%`-prefixed operand emission, and target-specific rejection of system-reserved general registers such as g5 alongside stack, frame, and return-address registers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `callconv/sparc.rs`, this file defines SPARC inline-assembly registers, `%`-prefixed emission, and target-specific reserved-register validation such as SPARC32 `g5`, rather than offset-based function ABI lowering.
